messages:
marta (partnerships): Ok team — kicking off the Silica Systems HW preview. NDA is signed, they've handed over a small rack to our lab and want a 2-week turnup + benchmark pass before the marketplace listing discussion.
kevin (silica-eng): thanks! we've got two nodes racked at lab-3, GPU firmware v1.3.3. I'll drop access creds in 1:1 per NDA. Test image uses our spec: ubuntu-22 + cuda 12.
sam (eng-ml): can we target Llama2-70B fp16 + int8 runs? want latency and throughput baseline. also need KV cache perf metrics.
olivia (eng-runtime): noted. i'll spin up the runtime on those nodes tomorrow. can someone confirm the seq len we should use for perf? 512? 2048?
vikas (product): 512 for latency SLA, but also include a 2k seq run as a stress case. marketplace listing will want a short summary table: tps @ batch1, p50/p95 latency, cost estimate.
nina (solutions): i'll coordinate SI integration checklist — we need sample terraform, VPC peering notes, and a short runbook for customers who buy through the marketplace.
kevin (silica-eng): thanks Nina. FYI firmware change yesterday fixed a small NVLink flake. should be stable for the pass.
marta (partnerships): timeline: day0 access + env, day1 smoke, day2-6 bench runs & perf tuning, day7 report draft, day10 SI test, day14 readiness review & go/no-go for marketplace draft.
sam (eng-ml): quick note on metrics — please capture: tokens/sec, token-cost estimate, GPU utilization, KV cache hit rate, memory headroom, and any oom events. stash raw logs to s3 path: s3://redwood-eap/silica/1758001234/.
olivia (eng-runtime): small config we'll test:
```
export RW_BATCH_MAX=8
export KV_CACHE_ENABLED=1
./run_bench --model llama2-70b --seq 512 --iters 200
```
please don't run with RW_BATCH_MAX > 8 until I confirm queue behavior.
kevin (silica-eng): acknowledged. i'll coordinate thermal monitoring and provide BMC creds to olivia.
marta (partnerships): NDA reminder — do not share raw traces externally. public-facing slides should use aggregated numbers and our approved wording. I'll draft a short comms blurb.
vikas (product): OK for comms: we want to avoid any direct model perf claims vs public clouds. phrase: "validated throughput and latency on Silica X nodes".
nina (solutions): SI checklist action items: 1) terraform example 2) networking diagram 3) troubleshooting runbook 4) sample telemetry dashboard. I'll own 1+2.
sam (eng-ml): how do we handle failover? if a node drops should the runtime fallback to hosted instances? we should test fallback path.
olivia (eng-runtime): runtime supports policy-based routing. i'll set a canary policy that prefers on-prem node, falls back to hosted small instance pool; will test with induced failure.
marta (partnerships): milestone: if bench numbers look good at day7, we schedule a joint customer preview invite (no public announcement) and start marketplace copy. if any blocker, we pause the listing.
deploy-bot: build #3421 for infra/bench-runner passed — image pushed: gcr.io/redwood/bench-runner:2026-03-05-3421 :white_check_mark:
kevin (silica-eng): sweet. we'll standby for creds. also sending a brief telemetry schema so you can wire it into your dashboards.
vikas (product): one more ask — can we capture a short cost model (tokens/sec -> $/hour estimate) so sales has a rough MSRP for marketplace listing.
marta (partnerships): agreed. sam + olivia can pair on cost calc. i'll schedule a 30m sync for tomorrow 10:30am PT. action items recap: Marta: comms draft + sync; Kevin: creds + telemetry schema; Olivia: runtime + canary config; Sam: bench runs + cost model; Nina: terraform + diag. Back here after day2 smoke. :rocket:
